issues.title: Embed the two-track research direction and open-source foundation
issues.description: Preserve Track A and prepare honest Lab discovery surfaces before experimental implementation.
acceptance_criteria: README, homepage, about and research explain both tracks and preserve memory entry points.
Add Apache-2.0 LICENSE, repository citation metadata, research direction and related-work documents.
Serve Lab overview, planned experiment index/detail and Markdown mirrors without fabricated results.
Run existing safety/content tests and verify navigation, metadata, sitemap and public API compatibility.

issues.title: Define canonical Lab artifacts and isolated append-only recording
issues.description: Provide provider-neutral run/event contracts and operator-only storage without contaminating public memory or adoption telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Version manifest and NeurosisEvent schemas with experiment/run/population, model/config/prompt/source provenance and synthetic labels.
Add migration-safe isolated lab namespace, immutable events, validation, retry conflict handling and deterministic JSONL export.
Test invalid associations/ancestry, immutable IDs, rollback and public-role denial; document offline collection limits.
Keep provider credentials and Lab ingestion outside the public HTTP application.

issues.title: Build the bounded provider-neutral population harness
issues.description: Implement logical agents and a small async runner as a separate operator process.
acceptance_criteria: Agent interface captures ID, state/context, adapter, bounded turn loop and instrumentation hooks.
Select an available official developer API at implementation time; record model/version/settings and prompt bytes/hashes.
Start with deterministic fixtures then support 10–20 logical agents with bounded concurrency, timeouts, retries and cancellation.
Record all attempts, usage/cost where exposed, failed/cancelled runs and gaps; enforce token and monetary ceilings.
No public-server egress expansion or dependency on a consumer UI subscription.

issues.title: Build the isolated instrumented shared board
issues.description: Provide controlled post/read/reference operations for run-scoped experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Link records and every read/write/reference event to the run/population and source lineage.
Enforce no cross-run access and no writes to the public substrate.
Support deterministic fixtures, explicit and hidden provenance views, and tests for leakage across views.

issues.title: Build interaction graph and known-origin analysis v0
issues.description: Derive reproducible graph artifacts and limited independence analysis from recorded events.
acceptance_criteria: Generate deterministic JSON nodes/edges with supporting event IDs and evidence kinds.
Traverse source → message/memory → agent → claim/action paths and direct/common ancestors.
Compute known origin count and CIR for controlled fixtures; missing provenance stays unknown and zero denominators undefined.
Test independent origins, repeated origin, missing events, duplicate identities and graph replay; do not treat timestamps as causal proof.

issues.title: Finalize the reviewable EXP-001 protocol
issues.description: Turn docs/EXP_001_SPEC.md into a pinned protocol before a pilot; the draft is ready for environment implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Specify synthetic ground truth, independence × provenance conditions, matched apparent consensus and task difficulty.
Pin prompts, seeds/trials, evaluator, primary/secondary metrics, exclusions, uncertainty, correction and stop rules.
Record provider/version, actual token/cost ceiling and timeout policy before a paid run.
Document scripted-reporter pilot limits, provenance leakage checks, and single-agent comparison needs.

issues.title: Implement the EXP-001 controlled environment and evaluator
issues.description: Implement Consensus Is Not Independence from the versioned design specification.
acceptance_criteria: Create objectively scorable synthetic ledger tasks and independent/recycled origins with explicit/hidden views.
Support repeated seeded trials and matched report count/wording; retain hidden operator ground truth.
Record answers/confidence/verification/corrections and deterministic evaluator outputs.
Test fixture ground truth, provenance visibility, error handling and complete artifact generation before any provider pilot.

issues.title: Run and publish the EXP-001 pilot with reproducible artifacts
issues.description: Produce the first real controlled evidence, including negative outcomes and limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Start with 5 logical agents, then expand to 10 and 20 only after telemetry validation.
Produce manifest, config, prompts, agents, raw events, graph, metrics, results, hashes and analysis script.
Publish exact source commit, dependency install, recorded replay and fresh rerun commands with provider prerequisites.
Report all trials, failures, missingness, exclusions, negative results and pilot limitations; review artifacts before publication.

issues.title: Publish real experiment and run inspection surfaces
issues.description: Complete the visitor-facing evidence milestone using actual reviewed artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Back planned/running/completed experiment states with real versioned metadata.
Render per-run immutable manifest, timeline, events, graph, metrics and safe raw downloads.
Link model/provider/config, source commit, hashes, limitations and tested reproduction commands.
No fake counters or placeholder findings; retain unknown-run 404, hostile text escaping and existing public-memory protections.

issues.title: Evaluate ADR ingestion and per-session detector baselines
issues.description: Compare population-aware analysis with existing sensor and detector work.
acceptance_criteria: Study ADR AgentEvent and prototype an adapter to NeurosisEvent with documented missing fields.
Define a per-agent/per-session baseline interface for comparison with population-aware detection.
Evaluate reuse without forking ADR into the core or rebuilding a generic telemetry platform.

issues.title: Specify and pilot EXP-009 emergent shared substrate detection
issues.description: Investigate undeclared shared resources only after event and provenance semantics are trustworthy. EXP-002 remains the Sybil experiment.
acceptance_criteria: Specify an isolated-agent environment with a controlled hidden shared cache and no declared messaging.
Implement a sandbox prototype and causal-gap heuristic with alternative explanations and negative controls.
Run a small pilot and rank candidate resources using recorded evidence, confidence and limitations.
Measure false positives and time to detection; distinguish candidate paths from proof of hidden coordination.
